pages.scan: Opened works/auto-6294ee8a2094/workflow/review/page-01.png with Read and looked at it before any other document. Three panels: a wide establishing panel, then two panels side by side on the bottom row.
pages.observation: My natural reading order matched the layout. Panel 1: the caption 'A busy day at Dr. Ananya's clinic.' sits top-left over wall and sky, and covers no face. The doctor in a white coat waves an elderly woman inside while patients wait on chairs. Panel 2 (bottom-left): 'Appointments, patient details, follow-ups...' then 'I wish everything were easier to manage!'. Both tails reach the receptionist, who is on the phone and writing in a ledger. The first tail is long and angled, but it clearly ends at her head. Panel 3 (bottom-right): 'Our time belongs with patients. Let's make the rest simpler.' The tail reaches the doctor, who has her hand on her chin, and it reads as a reply to panel 2. No balloon covers a face, hand, phone or ledger. Foreground patients' heads in panel 2 are cropped by the panel edge, not by lettering. Minor: one speaker has two balloons in panel 2, which reads acceptably left to right. Nothing confusing. No required change.
